mapper.sql: SELECT p.project_id, p.bid_no, p.notice_id, p.project_name, p.tenderee, p.agent, p.region_code, p.industry, p.budget_amount, p.bid_amount, p.status, p.join_type, p.partner, p.apply_deadline, p.submit_deadline, p.open_time, p.result_time, p.fail_reason, p.owner_user_id, p.owner_name, p.dept_id, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark FROM bid_project p
mapper.select: WHERE p.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND p.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY p.project_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_project (bid_no, notice_id, project_name, tenderee, agent, region_code, industry, budget_amount, bid_amount, status, join_type, partner, apply_deadline, submit_deadline, open_time, result_time, fail_reason, owner_user_id, owner_name, dept_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{bidNo}, #{noticeId}, #{projectName}, #{tenderee}, #{agent}, #{regionCode}, #{industry}, #{budgetAmount}, #{bidAmount}, #{status}, #{joinType}, #{partner}, #{applyDeadline}, #{submitDeadline}, #{openTime}, #{resultTime}, #{failReason}, #{ownerUserId}, #{ownerName}, #{deptId}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE bid_project SET del_flag = '2' WHERE project_id IN #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.node_id, n.project_id, n.node_type, n.node_name, n.plan_time, n.actual_time, n.handler_id, n.handler_name, n.block_desc, n.finish_flag, n.sort_order, n.del_flag, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark FROM bid_project_node n WHERE n.project_id = #{projectId} AND n.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY n.sort_order ASC, n.node_id ASC

SELECT n.node_id, n.project_id, n.node_type, n.node_name, n.plan_time, n.actual_time, n.handler_id, n.handler_name, n.block_desc, n.finish_flag, n.sort_order, n.del_flag, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark FROM bid_project_node n WHERE n.node_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_project_node (project_id, node_type, node_name, plan_time, actual_time, handler_id, handler_name, block_desc, finish_flag, sort_order, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{nodeType}, #{nodeName}, #{planTime}, #{actualTime}, #{handlerId}, #{handlerName}, #{blockDesc}, #{finishFlag}, #{sortOrder}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE bid_project_node SET del_flag = '2' WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
UPDATE bid_project_node SET del_flag = '2' WHERE node_id IN #{nodeId}
mapper.select: WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status IN ('1','2','3','4','5') AND ( (p.apply_deadline IS NOT NULL AND p.apply_deadline BETWEEN sysdate() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)) OR (p.submit_deadline IS NOT NULL AND p.submit_deadline BETWEEN sysdate() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)) OR (p.open_time IS NOT NULL AND p.open_time BETWEEN sysdate() AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)) )
SELECT p.status AS "status", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM bid_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY p.status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS "month", COUNT(1) AS "total", SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = '7' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "won", COALESCE(SUM(p.bid_amount), 0) AS "bidAmount", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = '7' THEN p.bid_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "wonAmount" FROM bid_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY "month"
SELECT p.fail_reason AS "failReason", COUNT(1) AS "cnt" FROM bid_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.fail_reason IS NOT NULL AND p.fail_reason != '' GROUP BY p.fail_reason

SELECT COUNT(1) AS "totalProjects", SUM(CASE WHEN p.status IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "ongoing", SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = '7' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "won", SUM(CASE WHEN p.status IN ('8','9') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "lost", SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = '7' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status IN ('7','8','9') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "winRate" FROM bid_project p WHERE p.del_flag = '0'
